+# r.208 — the evidence, measured on the r.207 bytes first
+
+Kept in the repo rather than cited from a session directory, because a citation that points at nothing is not evidence
+(the r.208 round, spiral-backward lens). Every number below was produced by booting the SHIPPED r.207 deck
+(`drone-2525_r.207.html`, sha256 `dc266e89…`) and the built r.208 deck (`HASHES_r208.sha256`) in headless Chromium at
+390×844 and driving them with the same scripts.
+
+## 1 · The defect, on r.207
+
+The Capital entered through its own picker, at **MoT 1.1 — the default fidelity**:
+
+| | budget | drawn | dropped | `state.ownSegs` | the stage |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
+| **r.207** | 280 | 280 | **1,278** | **0** | black — no Capitol |
+| **r.208** | 280 | 280 | 608 | **208** | the building, the dome, the Goddess |
+
+Instrumented at the call site on r.207 by wrapping `drawTargets`: entered at **5** segments spent, left at **280** —
+eight door targets × (a 12-edge box + a 29-segment bullseye) = **328**, more than the whole budget, so `WIRE.g` was
+never reached and all 217 edges of the Capital scene (the building's own 76 among them) were dropped.

+## 3 · The four deck rows
+
+Said precisely, because the first draft of this record overclaimed it: the four new rows **cannot be run on the r.207
+bytes**. `THE_CAPITOL_IS_DRAWN` reads `state.ownSegs` after a Capital frame, `CAPITOL_IS_THE_SOURCED_BUILDING` measures
+groups that do not exist there, `EVERY_EDGE_HAS_A_LAWFUL_WEIGHT` reads a field `add()` did not carry, and
+`THE_SCENARIO_PICKER_OPENS_THE_SCENARIO` presses a door that was not there. What is red on r.207 is the **measured fact
+each row encodes** — section 1 for the first, the 62 m spire and the 14 m Great Walk for the second, one width for the
+whole world for the third, and a picker that only toasted for the fourth. On r.208 all four are green, inside a boot QA
+of **241/242** at 390×844, 844×390 and 375×667 with `SYNC_DIRECT` the only red, and **240/242** at 667×375 where `EYE_SCALE_12_IN` is red as it already is on r.207 (235/237 there).

+## 4 · The range, played rather than asserted

+|---|---|---|---|
+| TRAIN UP (`scripts/drone-trainup-play.mjs`) | 34 entries | 34 entries | **yes, byte for byte** |
+| QUAL 40 (`scripts/drone-qual40-play.mjs`) | 168 entries · 40 shots · 3 reloads · 40 of 40 EXPERT · 231 s | 168 entries · identical throughout | **yes, byte for byte** |
